lessons_used: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +4.5%, +3.1%), but carries severe downside risk (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too optimistic.
Targeted copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA predictions being too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted).
General intro and adoption protection copy changes showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, frequently causing significant performance drops worse than predicted (-7.0%, -10.1%, -19.3%) or showing no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screen progress indicators, and checklist layout adjustments showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate view to use a stage layout, putting full visual emphasis on finalizing pet details.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a long median time of 89s.

adoption_certificate.headline: Finalize Your Desktop Pet Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your companion's details to safely complete adoption.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off, but UI redesigns carry severe downside risk (-11.7% historical).

candidates.title: Post-Setup Launch Preparation Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated final launch preparation screen before launching the pet onto the desktop screen.
candidates.why: The overall onboarding completion rate is only 22.1%, with a 67.1% finish step conversion and 3 support complaints regarding pet visibility.

new_launch_prep.headline: Ready to Summon Companion
new_launch_prep.body: Your desktop pet is generated and ready to appear on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new launch preparation screen within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails and funnel, but adding new screens adds drop-off risk and requires major build effort.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In Before Certificate
candidates.change: Shift sign-in screen to take place after photo upload and right before adoption certificate confirmation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-signing in, requiring account binding right before certificate issuance.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in before adoption certificate is permitted under onboarding flexibility.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support tickets; reordering has modest historical success (+1.5%).

candidates.title: Photo Verification Flow Step
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated photo confirmation screen into the adoption sequence to verify rendering quality.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during adoption.

new_photo_review.headline: Review Pet Render Quality
new_photo_review.body: Ensure your custom pet image looks correct before adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a photo review screen during onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targeting custom pet issue with a new screen increases friction, carrying performance risk.

candidates.title: Sign-In Save Data Clarification
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly clarify that signing in binds pet save data permanently.
candidates.why: 8 emails in support complained that pets were reset or missing after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Your companion progress and custom attributes will be permanently tied to this account.

guard.reason: Updating copy on the sign-in screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Direct support mail evidence and high confidence from past account persistence copy win (+3.5%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Status Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the waiting screen clarifying background setup and file placement.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to show up on the desktop.

waiting.hint: Assets are loading into system memory. Please leave this window open until launch.

guard.reason: Adding helpful setup hints to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Easy config hint addressing long wait times, but hints generally have low impact.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Completion Alert Toggle
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification options and time estimates on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while waiting.

guard.reason: Enabling notification options and real time estimates on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high waiting duration; wait info changes historically yield around +1.0% lift.

candidates.title: Path Selection Starter Perk Copy
candidates.change: Frame path selection headline around claiming initial pet perks and starter traits.
candidates.why: The choose_path step drops 21.7% of starting users with a mean completion time of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path & Unlock Starter Perks
choose_path.body: Select a journey path to customize your companion's initial traits and perks.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlocking starter perks, violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning gifts, perks, discounts, or free extras.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Welcome Screen Layout
candidates.change: Change the home_intro screen layout to full_bleed for maximum visual call-to-action impact.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is high (67.1% conversion) with long mean time (5815s), and past launch CTA copy changes delivered massive conversion boosts.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home_intro screen layout inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but past finish step layout adjustments caused conversion drops (-5.6%).

candidates.title: Story Step Flexibility Hint
candidates.change: Add a reassurance hint on the story screen informing users that companion choices can be adjusted later.
candidates.why: Choose path shows long mean duration (514s), suggesting user hesitation when committing to paths.

story.hint: All path and pet choices can be changed at any time in app settings.

guard.reason: Adding reassurance hints on the story screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint for long duration step; past choose_path copy/hints showed minimal effect (+0.2%).

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +4.5%, +3.1%), but carries risk of severe drops (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with predictions often being inaccurate.

Targeted copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA predictions being too low (+0.5% predicted vs +6.7% measured). General intro copy showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns carry severe downside risk (-7.0%, -10.1%, -14.1%, -19.3%), consistently performing worse than predicted or showing no clear effect, with no winning tests.
Hints can actively hurt performance (-3.1%) or show no clear effect.
Notifications, waiting screen progress indicators, and layout adjustments showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.
